purpose: Assess useful generative diversity, reconstruction limits and compute efficiency before ensemble distillation
authorization: 2026-10-01: user approved full plan, earlier ESM layers and question-appropriate GPU run lengths; at most 8 GPUs queued plus running

stages.name: adapter_calibration
stages.data: 16 previously mapped training structures; not the ensemble evaluation panel
stages.experiment: Re-encode complete N/CA/C/O source coordinates, compare cached latents/reconstructions; paired 8 decoder seeds at 3 and 10 steps; strict FP32

stages.name: curation
stages.rules: Freeze residue mapping and state features before model predictions; sequence-family isolation for reserved confirmation and teacher pilot; preserve original 34-test quarantine; record inherited training overlaps and environmental conditions

stages.name: diversity
stages.ours: 32 latent seeds with fixed decoder; 32 decoder seeds at fixed latent; 8x4 factorial; CFG1/2 sensitivity on 8 proteins
stages.teacher: ESMFold2-Fast 32 samples, extend to128 only if coverage rises; fixed trunk3, diffusion50; 25/50/100 step sensitivity on8 proteins; validate conditioner reuse

stages.name: layers
stages.rules: One extraction pass retaining only selected layers; matched capacity/data/update budgets and sequence-disjoint evaluation; decoded ensemble metrics

stages.name: conditional_training
stages.gate: Proceed only if teacher adds valid state coverage and ProteinAE preserves alternative states; one paired training-seed screen followed by three-seed replication only for eligible arm

statistics: Targets/families are independent units; seeds are repeated sampling; physical populations claimed only against appropriate reference ensembles; retain and report rejected samples
resources: Profile each new workload on one H200; scale independent workloads up to eight queued+running; adapt individual Slurm walltimes to measured cost; do not install into inherited environment
test: Original 34 locked targets unscored. New confirmation panel reserved before tuning.
